{"compatibility":"major","safety_note_md":"# SafeStan Safety Note

Compatibility: major.

Protected data: `grade`.

Generated files: none.

Reason: the training responses `grade` are the only data scored by sampling statements; `item` and `subject` are predictors, and the holdout variables are context for generated predictions. The original model observes `grade[response]` inside a loop rather than observing the top-level protected variable with one plain sampling statement. In addition, several latent hyperparameters (`mu_first_difficulty`, `sigma_ability`, `sigma_first_difficulty`, and `sigma_step`) have only implicit improper flat/constrained priors, while SafeStan requires every parameter to have exactly one built-in prior before use. Adding proper priors would change the posterior/log density. The `difficulty` prior is also expressed on slices and differences rather than as a single built-in prior for a top-level parameter. An equivalent SafeStan translation would therefore require substantive reparameterization and prior/density changes, not a minor mechanical rewrite.
","model_safe_stan":"","data_safe_json":"","protected_variables":[]}

data_safe_json.description: Valid JSON object text for data_safe.json, or empty string for major rewrites.

model_safe_stan.description: Full model_safe.stan content, or empty string for major rewrites.

protected_variables.description: Top-level data variables to pass to --sstan-protect.
